items.text: Page title pairs the brand name with a positioning phrase, separated by a pipe
items.evidence: title: "Ridetech | Performance Suspension Specialist"

items.text: Heading levels are not in order: h4s like 'PERFORMANCE SUSPENSION SPECIALIST' sit directly under an h2, and h3s appear after h4s
items.evidence: heading_outline: h2 RIDETECH.COM → h4 PERFORMANCE SUSPENSION SPECIALIST → h3 DON'T SEE WHAT YOU'RE LOOKING FOR?

items.text: Footer contact details are marked up with an address element
items.evidence: tag_counts.address: 1; footer shows '350 S. St. Charles St, Jasper, Indiana, 47546'

items.text: The page has many links but little text: 115 anchors and 92 list items against 342 words
items.evidence: anchors: 115; li: 92; text_stats.words: 342

items.text: Two font families are used: Helvetica Neue for nearly all text, and Impact for a few display headings
items.evidence: fonts_by_element_count: Helvetica Neue 333, Impact 9

items.text: Each section heading has a short red underline bar beneath it, aligned to the left
items.evidence: Red rule under 'SHOP BY VEHICLE', 'SHOP BY PRODUCT', 'LATEST NEWS', 'GET CONNECTED'; centred under 'RIDETECH.COM'

items.text: Body text is set at 16px with a 1.6 line height
items.evidence: body_font_size 16px, body_line_height 25.6px

items.text: Navigation, card labels, buttons and footer column titles use uppercase bold sans-serif
items.evidence: 'PRODUCTS APPLICATIONS NEWS TECH', 'MUSCLE CARS AND CLASSICS', 'REQUEST A CATALOG', 'CONTACT INFO'

items.text: The palette is limited to white, light grey, near-black and one red accent (rgb 215,25,32)
items.evidence: top_backgrounds: white 38, rgb(244,244,244) 13, rgb(20,20,20) 3, rgb(215,25,32) 3, black 1

items.text: Body text is near-black rgb(20,20,20) rather than pure black
items.evidence: body_color rgb(20,20,20); top text color with 245 elements

items.text: Light grey rgb(204,204,204) is the second most common text colour, used for links on the dark footer
items.evidence: top_text_colors: rgb(204,204,204) 59; footer links appear grey on rgb(20,20,20)

items.text: Section backgrounds alternate between white and light grey (#f4f4f4), separating content bands without borders
items.evidence: Shop by Vehicle on white, Shop by Product on grey, catalog on white, Latest News on grey

items.text: A thin near-black utility bar at the very top holds a phone number on the left and account/newsletter/catalog links on the right
items.evidence: slice 0 top: '☎ 812.481.4787' left; 'Sign Up for News! Get a FREE Catalog Login / Register' right

items.text: The main header puts the logo, four text nav links, a search input and a cart total on one row, all left of centre, leaving empty space on the right
items.evidence: slice 0: logo at x=136, then PRODUCTS…TECH, Search box, 'Cart $0.00' ending around x=1003

items.text: The logo is a red-and-black wordmark with a stacked icon, rendered as a PNG at about half its natural size
items.evidence: ridetech-logo-red-black-icon.png natural 389×87, rendered 197×44

items.text: The hero is a full-width strip of four equal tiles, each 360×240, cropped from much wider 1920×450 banner images, so the banner text is cut off at the edges
items.evidence: images silverado-copy.jpg, ridepro-e5.jpg, falcon.jpg, camaro-subframe…jpg each rect w 360 h 240 at x 0/360/720/1080; visible clipped text l

items.text: Below the hero, a solid red full-width band announces free shipping, with an Impact heading and an uppercase subline
items.evidence: 'FREE SHIPPING' / 'FREE GROUND SHIPPING TO THE CONTINENTAL U.S. FOR ORDERS OF $100 OR MORE' on rgb(215,25,32)

items.text: 'Shop by Vehicle' uses five equal bordered cards, each with a red car-silhouette image over a label
items.evidence: images muscle-car.png, modern-muscle.png, truck.png, hot-rod.png, corvette.png each 216×121 in a row at y=591

items.text: Product and vehicle cards have a red horizontal rule between the image and the label
items.evidence: A red line at the image/label boundary on every image card in slices 0–1

items.text: Square 300×300 product images are shown in a 4:3 frame (275×206), so they are cropped or scaled to fit
items.evidence: natural [300,300] vs rect 275×206

items.text: Product photos are cut-out parts on white backgrounds with no lifestyle context
items.evidence: Coilovers, shock absorbers, control arms and sway bars on white in slices 0–1

items.text: 'Shop by Product' is a 4-column card grid. The first 11 cards have square-source product photos, and the rest are text-only grey tiles
items.evidence: 11 category images at 275×206 (natural 300×300) in rows at y 962/1261/1559; then text tiles 'LEVELTOW KITS', 'TRU TURN', 'TIGERCAGE', … 'BUS

items.text: Cards use square or barely rounded corners with no shadows

items.text: There are no gradients, backdrop blur, CSS animations or transforms. Only transitions are present

items.text: The catalog promo is a two-column split: a 3D catalog cover image on the left, and a stacked heading with a red CTA button and a text link on the right

items.text: Secondary links end in a right arrow character and are set in red bold text
items.evidence: '1,000,001 Mile Warranty →', 'View all news →'

items.text: Primary buttons are solid red rectangles with white uppercase bold text and square corners

items.text: News items are text-only cards (no thumbnails) in two columns, each with a thick red left border

items.text: Dated content is visible: the news refers to May 2021 events and the footer copyright reads 2021

items.text: The about band has a centred Impact heading, a pink-red letter-spaced uppercase subheading, and a centred paragraph of SEO-style product keywords

items.text: Social and contact links are shown as ghost buttons: white 1px outline boxes with white bold text on the dark photo

items.text: The copy uses exclamation marks for an enthusiastic tone

items.text: Layout mixes CSS grid and flexbox

items.text: The page loads few resources: one stylesheet and one script. There are no inline SVGs, and only 4 inline style attributes

items.text: Landmark elements are used: one header, nav, main and footer, plus 6 sections. There are no article, aside or figure elements

features.statement: Page title pairs a brand name with a positioning phrase, separated by a pipe
Heading levels skip and run out of order, with h4s directly under h2s and h3s after h4s
Footer contact details are marked up with an address element
Link-dense page with many anchors and list items relative to a small amount of body text
Two font families: a neutral sans-serif for nearly all text and a heavy condensed display face for a few headings
Section headings have a short red accent underline bar beneath them
Body text is 16px with a roomy 1.6 line height
Navigation, card labels, buttons and footer column titles use uppercase bold sans-serif text
Palette is restricted to white, light grey, near-black and a single red accent
Links on the dark footer are set in light grey rather than white
Section backgrounds alternate between white and light grey to separate bands without borders
A thin dark utility bar at the top holds a phone number left and account links right
Header places logo, text nav links, search input and cart total on a single row with spacious gaps
A solid red full-width promotional band uses a display heading and an uppercase subline
Hero is a full-width strip of equal tiles cropped from wider banner images, clipping their text
Category cards sit in equal-width grids with an image above an uppercase label
Image cards have a red horizontal rule between the image and its label
Product photos are isolated cut-out items on white backgrounds, without lifestyle context
Square source images are cropped or rescaled into a different aspect-ratio frame
Cards and boxes have square or barely rounded corners and no shadows
No gradients, backdrop blur, animations or transforms; only simple transitions are used
Promo section is a two-column split with an image on the left and heading, CTA and link on the right
Secondary links are bold red text ending with a right-arrow character
Primary buttons are solid red rectangles with white uppercase bold text and square corners
News items are text-only cards with a thick red left border in two columns
Secondary actions appear as ghost buttons with thin white outlines and white bold text on dark backgrounds
Copy uses exclamation marks for an enthusiastic, promotional tone
Newsletter form places labelled name and email fields and a red submit button on one row
Footer has a thin divider above a bottom row with copyright left and 'Back to top' link right
Content sits in a centered fixed-width container while hero images and colour bands run full-bleed
Landmark elements (header, nav, main, section, footer) are used, without article, aside or figure
Layout mixes CSS grid and flexbox
Subheading text is letter-spaced uppercase in a lighter red, followed by a centred keyword-rich paragraph
